items.followUp: What is the advantage of software sharing in a network?

rubric.why: Identifies the main advantage of hardware sharing.
rubric.description: States that network users can share hardware or devices.
rubric.how: Look for users sharing hardware or the same devices.

rubric.why: States a practical benefit of sharing devices.
rubric.description: Explains that hardware sharing reduces the cost of providing devices.
rubric.how: Look for reduced cost or expense.

modelAnswer: Hardware sharing allows several users on a network to use the same devices, such as a printer or scanner.
It reduces the cost of buying a separate device for every user.
